sloka: हन्तास्मि त्वां सहामात्यं सपुत्रज्ञातिबान्धवम् ।निरुद्विग्नास्त्रयो लोका भविष्यन्ति हते त्वयि ।। ६.४१.७८ ।।।।
transliteration: hantāsmi tvāṁ sahāmātyaṁ saputrajñātibāndhavam ।nirudvignāstrayo lokā bhaviṣyanti hate tvayi ।। 6.41.78 ।।।।

translations.english: "I am the son of Vali,by name Angada,an envoy of Rama ,the king of Kosala of unwearied action. You may know that I have landed"
